page.layout: One page of running text in a single block, with narrowing lines in the middle. Small marginal marks ("10" and faint marks) in the right margin. Ornament mid-page below the text block. Catchword "RERVM" at the lower right. Running head at the top.

main_text.p: Scotorum Nobilitatem esse extinguendam : in eorum autem prædijs mille Cataphra-ctos equites, Gallos, collocari posse : reliquam multitudinem, seruorum loco, ha-bendam. Id consilium, literis eius ad Gallum intercepitis, divulgarum, mirum, quan-tum Gallorum odium, iam alijs de causis natum auxit. Ambianus autem Episcopus non modo Romanæ causæ minus æquos, sed etiam Gallorum partibus minus, quam ipse censebat æquum, addictos, indicta causa agere, rapere, trucidare, iubebat : Gal-losque milites graviter increpabat, quod, sui Regis inimicos palam omnium oculis impune se ostentare, paterentur : unum etiam nominatim designa-bat, Gulielmum Metellanum, iuuenem nobilem & eruditum, 10quem, quia Sorbonici rationibus refellere non poterant, ferro Episcopus tollere destinabat : eiusque Gallis militibus vitam exprobrabat, & mortem commendabat. Id ille cum resciisset, ca-ptato tempore, se a Gallis subduxit, & in Sco-torum castra venit.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "divulgarum" (possibly "divulgarunt") and "paterentur" (scan reads close to "patarentur"); both copied as seen, not marked with [?] because the letters are legible in the scan. Small faint marks in the right margin near the middle lines are unreadable and omitted. The central ornament below the text block is a printer's fleuron, not text, and is left out. No page number is printed on this page.
